subject: multiple group analsis: intercept equal across groups

messages.author: c72fc7caf26ddaca
messages.subject: multiple group analsis: intercept equal across groups
parts:
Hi there,
 
I'm estimating a fairly simple path analysis model with two endogenous variables (one binary and the other continuous).
 
My question relates to the intercept for the continuous endogenous variables and the single threshold for the binary endogenous variable, both of which seem to be constrained to be equal as a default across all groups in my multiple group analysis, while the coefficients (and everything else that can) are free to vary as I would expect. Does anyone know why these intercepts are constrained to be equal as a default, and how to allow them to vary?
 
Any and all help greatly appreciated.
 
Regards,
 
Killian.

messages.subject: Re: multiple group analsis: intercept equal across groups
parts:
Hey Bruce, sure thing. It was a very simple/stupid mistake: Basically I was using the wrong syntax to constrain coefficients.
 
So say I want to constrain the effect of age to be the same across three groups: I was using a*age instead of c(a,a,a,)*age. The tutorial was very clear about this (once I took the time to read it!)
 
Hope this helps.
 
Regards,
 
Killian.
